trap.label: gerúndio
trap.wrong: It’s no use to cry over spilled milk.
trap.right: It’s no use crying over spilled milk.
trap.why: Worth e no use pedem -ing; em português seria infinitivo (“não adianta chorar”, mas muitos dizem “de chorar”).

mcq.q: It’s no use **___** about the exam.
The class was **___** boring that I left.

fix.wrong: Lia is not enough tall for the ride.
fix.right: Lia is not tall enough for the ride.
It was such an awful movie.

fix.wrong: It’s worth to repeat the test.

rewrite.prompt: Una com so… that: “The soup was hot. I couldn’t eat it.”
rewrite.answer: The soup was so hot that I couldn’t eat it.

rewrite.prompt: Use too… to: “The box is very heavy. I can’t lift it.”
rewrite.answer: The box is too heavy to lift.

rewrite.prompt: Use enough: “The lake is warm. We can swim.” (warm enough)
rewrite.answer: The lake is warm enough to swim in.
